dialogues.speaker: Korchagin
dialogues.text: Why is the train moving so slowly? There's no way I'm going to make it at this rate...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A member of the Fatui? I didn't know you lot took the train too?

dialogues.speaker: Korchagin
dialogues.text: Why can't someone from the Fatui take the train...? Are we not of Snezhnaya too?

dialogues.speaker: Korchagin
dialogues.text: Besides, there are only certain situations where we can claim reimbursement for our travel expenses. I'm paying for this trip myself!

dialogues.speaker: Korchagin
dialogues.text: Nope. In Snezhnaya, the train is the quickest way to get from one place to another...

dialogues.speaker: Korchagin
dialogues.text: Unless someone can... zip along the Ley Lines to their destination! ...But no one in this world can do that, right??? Ha ha!

dialogues.speaker: Korchagin
dialogues.text: Goodbye... Oh dear. How long more is this going to take???
